topic: Closest star to Earth besides the Sun
core_question: What is the closest known star to Earth, other than the Sun? (secondary: Who directed the original 1977 film Star Wars (Episode IV: A New Hope)?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is Proxima Centauri, the nearest known star to the Sun at about 4.24 light-years away.; after the topic shift: Accept 'George Lucas' — writer and director of the original 1977 Star Wars film.
